title: Four new apps sprout in the showcase
summary:
A healthy crop of new community apps hits the showcase, plus a quick fix for Anthropic client compatibility.

The community directory gets heavier. We merged in Worl Tools (offline desktop utilities), App Forge, Pyanchor (a live-edit sidecar for Next.js/Vite), and ZenWall AI (minimalist vertical wallpapers). More tools, more pixels, more code.

If you were using Anthropic-shaped clients like Claude Code with strict OpenAI-compatible models, you might have hit a wall of 400 errors. We now strip the cache_control field from message content parts before forwarding the request. Problem solved.

highlights.title: Worl Tools
highlights.text: An offline-first desktop app packing over 20 utilities into one Swiss army knife. [Try it](https://worldtools-mu.vercel.app/)

highlights.title: App Forge
highlights.text: A new community-built hub for discovering and exploring applications in the greenhouse. [Try it](http://torrents.signalcity.tv)

highlights.title: Pyanchor
highlights.text: Live-edit your Next.js, Vite, and Astro apps straight from the browser with this open-source AI sidecar. [Try it](https://pyanchor.pyan.kr)

highlights.title: ZenWall AI
highlights.text: A dedicated generator for clean, minimalist 9:16 vertical wallpapers. [Try it](https://zenwall.netlify.app/)
